summary_en: This study compares different endocrine (hormone-blocking) treatments given before surgery for men with hormone receptor-positive breast cancer. The drugs tested are tamoxifen, anastrozole, degarelix and abemaciclib, given alone or in combination. Tamoxifen and anastrozole are taken by mouth, degarelix is an injection under the skin, and abemaciclib is taken by mouth; some arms last 21 days and others last 4 cycles of 28 days (about 4 months). The record does not state a main outcome measure, so this is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio compara distintos tratamientos endocrinos (que bloquean las hormonas) administrados antes de la cirugía a hombres con cáncer de mama positivo para receptores hormonales. Los medicamentos evaluados son tamoxifeno, anastrozol, degarelix y abemaciclib, administrados solos o combinados. El tamoxifeno, el anastrozol y el abemaciclib se toman por vía oral, y el degarelix es una inyección debajo de la piel; algunos grupos duran 21 días y otros 4 ciclos de 28 días (unos 4 meses). El registro no indica un resultado principal, y se trata de un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Men 18 years or older with invasive breast cancer
Primary tumor and axillary nodes not yet surgically removed
Stage I, II, or III breast cancer
Hormone receptor-positive and HER2-negative breast cancer
ECOG performance status of 2 or less
not_for: Prior endocrine, chemotherapy, radiation, or investigational therapy for this breast cancer
Severe heart disease or heart failure (NYHA Class III or higher)
Personal history of certain heart rhythm problems or sudden cardiac arrest
Active systemic bacterial, fungal, or uncontrolled infection
